answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the plume of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the forge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the haven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
